required_controls: execute the source tree under UCAgent-main without source edits
use upstream workflow, prompts, checkers, and context middleware
delete only the upstream period stop sequence through a recorded CLI override
pin the minimum compatible LangChain and LangGraph dependency set
exercise the real stage-0 prompt and all UCAgent tools before every run
abort after three consecutive empty AI turns
use an isolated HOME so ~/.ucagent/setting.yaml cannot contaminate the run
same Q4_K_M model alias and 65536-token model context
same five-GPU Ollama server with no concurrent inference workload
do not mix this baseline with raw-upstream-invalid, legacy-workflow, or research-arm runs
fixed_configuration.note: This is the synchronized upstream UCAgent 0.9.1 behavioral baseline adapted only for the local Qwen OpenAI-compatible backend. The source tree remains unchanged. The recorded override removes the upstream stop sequence ['.'], which causes the 122B Qwen model to return an empty AIMessage with finish_reason=stop when the real 25-tool stage-0 request is used. A controlled replay with the same seed, messages, tools, and streaming mode returned ReadTextFile immediately after removing only that stop sequence. Prompt v1, data collection, long-term memory, failure-aware context, and context reuse remain disabled. The 51200 summary trigger is the upstream default and is distinct from the model's 65536-token context limit.
